task_definitions.establish_font_edition: Obtain a specimen of the adopted PUA edition, or document glyph continuity from edition-specific evidence.
task_definitions.locate_missing_specimen: Locate the adopted-edition specimen missing from the inspected font; do not substitute a fallback glyph.
task_definitions.compare_source_and_candidates: Compare the source specimen and every pinned candidate; record structural and regional differences.
task_definitions.disambiguate_candidates: Keep all candidates until source evidence supports a selection or an explicit ambiguity decision.
task_definitions.investigate_source_identifier: Investigate source-ID spelling and primary-source crosswalks; absence under exact-name search is not global absence.
task_definitions.inspect_cited_source: Inspect the bibliography or linked source in the pinned table row and establish a citable glyph identity.
task_definitions.locate_primary_source: Locate a primary specimen or definition for this edition-specific PUA identifier.
task_definitions.establish_numbered_target_edition: Establish the PUA edition intended by the numbered definition before transferring any correspondence.
task_definitions.compare_isolated_component: Compare the isolated component against its intended source; do not equate it with a transformed component in a full glyph.
task_definitions.resolve_ids_text_difference: Investigate the two source IDS descriptions; text differences do not by themselves establish glyph differences.

limitation: Research triage, not completed visual review or identity confirmation. Includes the U+EADD source-ID correction; the preview.1 database is unchanged.
